marco: quick sync pls — EU region experienced degraded inference earlier. Need statuspage + email copy + inbound routing plan. Drafting now.

marco: DRAFT status copy (short):

We experienced degraded inference performance in the EU region from 02:589:15 UTC. A configuration change impacted routing to a subset of GPU pools; the change was reverted and normal service resumed at 03:15 UTC. Traffic and health checks are stable. No customer data exposure was detected. A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours.

anya: Good start. Suggest we avoid "configuration" alone — "network configuration change" reads clearer for non-engineering customers.

jamie: For email segmentation: Dedicated + Private go immediate (within 60m) with detailed summary + SE outreach for any high-traffic customers. Hosted/Free tiers get a concise banner + link to status page in 3 hours.

devon: Support estimate: 10-25 tickets. Please include tag "incident-eu-03-2026" in subject and headers so we can filter and escalate. Also ask SEs to proactively call accounts >10% EU traffic.

lee: Sales-ops: if you get trial/demo requests from affected customers, flag to "sales-ops-incident" channel. Do not auto-forward to SDR queue.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-031: EU inference degradation 9:15 UTC - resolved at 1769501515 (03:15 UTC). Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime.

marco: Ops confirmed all checks passing. Update status snippet to: RESOLVED 9:15 UTC, traffic normalized and health checks green across EU clusters.

anya: Email subject suggestions: Dedicated/Private: "Service update 9:15 UTC 9: Impacting EU inference 9: Next steps". Hosted: "Service notice: EU inference briefly affected ". Keep hosted subject friendly.

jamie: Timing plan: 1) Post short status page update now (RESOLVED). 2) Send detailed email to Dedicated + Private in 45-60m with SEs CC'd. 3) Hosted banner + short email in 3h. 4) Blog/postmortem 48-72h with technical appendix.

devon: Confirmed — support will monitor ticket influx and provide a daily count. We'll mark high-priority tickets with prefix "incident-eu-03-2026".

marco: Marketing action items: finalize copy (I can finalize headline), prepare hosted banner, coordinate postmortem template with eng. Who owns the postmortem narrative?

anya: Marketing owns the customer-facing narrative. Engineering provides timeline, root cause, mitigations, and appendix. I'll schedule a sync with eng-runtime for the appendix.

lee: Routing: sales-ops will triage inbound lead emails and route demo requests to Account Execs; flag any potential renewals at risk.

marco: Final copy (status + email lead):

We experienced degraded inference performance in the EU region between 02:58 and 03:15 UTC. A network configuration change caused degraded routing to a subset of GPU clusters; the change was reverted and services returned to normal by 03:15 UTC. Traffic and health checks are stable. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident. A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours detailing root cause and mitigations.

If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai or your assigned SE.

anya: LGTM. Marco, please send the Dedicated + Private email in 45m and tag subject/header with "incident-eu-03-2026". Jamieson to deploy status update now.

jamie: Status update posted (RESOLVED). Banner queued for hosted email in 3h.

devon: Support queue watched. Currently seeing 3 tickets so far, trending low.

marco: Thanks team. We'll reconvene for the 72h postmortem draft meeting (calendar invite incoming). :thumbsup:
